name: Michael Johnston
bio: Michael Johnston (born February 22, 1996) is an American actor. He is best known for his role as Corey Bryant in the MTV series Teen Wolf and for his starring role as Bear in the horror film Obsession (2025).  He is also a voice actor for animation and video games.
